ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_regret_ratio_norm_relu_loss
ir.intuition: This loss changes paradigm from margin-based pairwise to a ratio-based regret normalization, leveraging the ratio of the log probability difference to the regret (delta_regret) plus a small constant for stability. It applies a ReLU activation on this normalized signal to focus on underperforming pairs, then aggregates by mean after weighting. This paradigm shifts from margin subtraction to regret-normalized scaling, emphasizing how much the model underestimates better pairs relative to regret, offering a distinct and theoretically grounded signal.
ir.pseudocode:
norm = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / (abs(delta_regret) + eps)
activated = relu(norm)
loss_vec = -logsigmoid(activated) * weight
loss = mean(loss_vec)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)

    eps = 1e-8

    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    denom = ops.add(ops.abs(delta_regret), eps)
    norm = ops.div(diff, denom)

    activated = ops.relu(norm)
    loss_vec = -ops.logsigmoid(activated)

    if weight is not None:
        loss_vec = loss_vec * weight

    loss = ops.mean(loss_vec)
    return loss
